decision: 10 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 8 for the 12 month period).
fact: Collision between Car 14 and Car 24 in turn 3.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. The driver of Car 14 attempted a very late overtake on Car 24 on the inside into turn 3. He never got in a position to have the right to the line and made contact with Car 24 at the apex. The Stewards determine that the driver of Car 14 was wholly at fault.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 14 Causing A Collision
to: The Team Manager, Aston Martin Aramco F1 Team
